_comment: Tier-2 for skfem convection_diffusion#3. Measured on skfem 12.0.1, a 1-D-in-x advection-diffusion boundary layer on MeshQuad, eps=1e-3, inlet 0 / outlet 1: plain CG undershoots at every mesh in a four-level refinement sweep (nx 10..80, cell Peclet 50 down to 6.25) and the undershoot never clears; SUPG with the standard coth-tau removes it at EVERY level including the coarsest. Sharpens the claim's 'do not damp under refinement': the undershoot does shrink, but it survives as long as the cell Peclet exceeds ~1, so clearing it by refinement alone costs more than an order of magnitude in DOFs.
